summary: Backend-only testing for eBay title cleaner. All 13 unit tests in tests/test_title_cleaner.py pass. Wrote 3 additional integration tests in tests/test_title_integration.py verifying (a) parse_ebay_item applies clean_ebay_title to a canned dirty HTML fixture producing the exact expected cleaned title, (b) parse_ebay_item still returns all expected keys (item_id, price_display, price_value, currency, condition, seller, images, specifics, description, variants, ebay_category_path), and (c) existing DB products fetched via GET /api/products retain their original titles (non-retroactive). Total 16/16 tests passing.
critical_code_review_comments: scraper.py is ~1093 lines; consider splitting title-cleaning heuristic into its own module (e.g. title_cleaner.py) for maintainability.
clean_ebay_title is a pure function ideal for extraction; would also make unit tests import path cleaner.
seed_data_creation: None. Used in-memory HTML fixture only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Title cleaner is verified. Live eBay scrape not attempted from test env (no need — canned HTML fixture proves parse_ebay_item invokes clean_ebay_title on extracted title). GET /api/products confirmed titles are untouched retroactively.
